title: Normalized Wave Functions
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct normalized wave functions for n = 1 to 4.

title: Energy Levels
description: Essential Criteria: The student must compute and present the correct energy levels for n = 1 to 4.

title: Probability Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the probabilities for finding the system in states n = 2, 3, and 4 after the perturbation.

title: Matrix Element Evaluation
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive the matrix elements correctly for the perturbation.

title: Sketches
description: Optional Criteria: The student should provide accurate sketches of the wave functions and energy levels.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes in the energy calculations.
